blurb: Guests join all day fishing excursions targeting salmon and halibut in Resurrection Bay and Kenai Fjords National Park. The experience includes opportunities to see land and aquatic wildlife and take photography. They also offer sightseeing and photography tours and transportation services such as hunting drops and water taxi.
